Create a single game tile sheet image for an isometric 2D game: FURNITURE AND OBJECTS for the
inside of Minoan sci-fi palace buildings. It must match the existing Minoan building tile set
exactly (attach minoan_palace_tile_sheet.png as the style reference): cream limestone, red
plaster, Minoan frescoes and motifs (charging bull, bull-leapers, dolphins, lilies, spirals,
waves, double axes, horns of consecration), red tapering Minoan columns with black capitals,
polished bronze and gold trim, deep blue tech panels with glowing cyan light strips, warm
terracotta pottery, dark red and cream cloth. Painted, detailed, clean edges, the same
rendering style, line weight and colour palette as the reference sheet across all pieces.

=== CANVAS (exact) ===
- Image size: exactly 2048 x 1920 pixels.
- Background: one flat solid colour, pure magenta #FF00FF, everywhere that is not a piece.
  No gradient, no texture, no vignette, no grid lines, no borders, no frames, no labels,
  no text, no title, no numbers, no drop shadows on the background.
- Grid: 8 columns x 6 rows of invisible cells, each cell exactly 256 x 320 pixels
  (cell x = col*256, cell y = row*320). Exactly ONE piece per cell, never crossing its cell.

=== PROJECTION (exact, no perspective) ===
- True 2:1 isometric (dimetric) pixel-art projection, the same as the building tiles: every
  receding edge rises exactly 1 pixel vertically per 2 pixels horizontally (26.565 deg).
  Vertical edges stay perfectly vertical. NO perspective, NO vanishing points, NO camera
  tilt - parallel lines stay parallel. Same projection and same scale for every piece.
- Light comes from the upper-left for every piece. Faces turned to the left/front-left are
  lit; faces turned to the right are about 20% darker.

=== SCALE AND PLACEMENT (exact, in pixels, relative to each cell's top-left corner) ===
- Scale: one floor tile (the diamond 256 x 128) is 2 x 2 metres; a wall storey is 240 px
  tall (3 metres), so 1 metre of height is 80 px. A chair seat is ~36 px above the floor,
  a table top ~60 px, a bed ~40 px, a cabinet ~150 px, a person would be ~140 px tall.
- The cell's floor diamond: top (128,176), right (256,240), bottom (128,304), left (0,240).
  Every object stands on that diamond, centred on it, its footprint inside it (big pieces
  like the bed and the long table fill most of it; small ones sit in its middle).
  Nothing wider than 240 px or taller than 300 px.
- Only a small soft contact shadow directly under each object, nothing else around it.
- "FACING LEFT" = the object's front turned toward the viewer's lower-left (its back runs
  along a wall going up-right). "FACING RIGHT" = front turned toward the lower-right.
  Rows 0 and 1 are the same eight objects in the two facings: re-drawn for each facing and
  its lighting (not mirrored), same size and design.

=== CELL CONTENTS (row by row, columns 0..7) ===
Row 0 - SEATS, BEDS AND TABLES, FACING LEFT:
  0 gryphon throne (tall gypsum throne with a wavy back, gryphons painted beside it),
  1 chair (bronze frame, red cushion), 2 stone bench (cream limestone, spiral frieze),
  3 couch / kline (bronze legs, cream mattress, red cushions),
  4 bed (wooden frame with gold inlays, red and cream bedding, a bolster),
  5 long dining table (dark wood, gold edge, a few cups and a fruit bowl on it),
  6 tech desk (cream stone desk with a blue holo screen glowing cyan above it),
  7 tall cabinet / shelf against a wall (wood and bronze, jars and scrolls on the shelves).
Row 1 - the same eight objects as row 0, in the same order, FACING RIGHT.
Row 2 - STORAGE AND KITCHEN (round or symmetric, one facing):
  0 group of three large pithoi (storage jars with rope patterns),
  1 wooden chest with bronze bands, 2 round three-legged table with a jug and cups,
  3 bronze tripod cauldron, 4 hearth (round clay hearth with embers),
  5 basket of fruit and bread on a low stool, 6 stack of amphorae in a rack,
  7 water basin on a stone stand.
Row 3 - SHRINE AND RITUAL:
  0 altar with gold horns of consecration, 1 snake-goddess statue on a pedestal,
  2 bull-head rhyton on a pedestal, 3 tall bronze double axe (labrys) on a stepped stand,
  4 offering table with libation cups, 5 tall bronze oil-lamp stand (small flame),
  6 incense burner with a thin wisp of smoke, 7 lustral basin (sunken stone basin with
  steps, water inside - drawn as a flat floor-level piece filling the diamond).
Row 4 - TECH AND WORK:
  0 control console (blue panels, cyan screens, gold trim), 1 holo-table (round, a cyan
  hologram of a planet above it), 2 power core (glowing cyan cylinder in a bronze cage),
  3 medical pod (cream capsule, cyan glass lid), 4 weapon rack (a laser bow, a laser rifle
  and a labrys hanging on it), 5 android charging alcove (bronze frame, cyan glow, empty),
  6 workbench with tools and a half-built bronze arm, 7 storage locker (blue and gold).
Row 5 - FLOOR ITEMS AND SMALL DECOR:
  0 rug with a red spiral pattern (flat on the floor, filling the diamond, no thickness),
  1 rug with blue dolphins and waves (flat, filling the diamond),
  2 pile of cushions, 3 potted lilies, 4 small olive tree in a painted pot,
  5 clay tablets and scrolls on a low stand, 6 loom with half-woven red cloth,
  7 broken pottery shards on the floor.

=== RULES ===
- Keep every piece inside its cell; leave at least 4 px of magenta around each piece.
- All pieces share one scale (the metres above) and stand on the same floor diamond.
- Do not use magenta (#FF00FF) or near-magenta colours anywhere in the artwork.
- No people, no text, no labels, no captions, no watermark anywhere on the image.
